tool.name: Microsoft Autopilot
tool.description: Always-on Copilot agent with its own Entra identity that works in Teams, Outlook and M365 on a user's behalf; built on OpenClaw.
strengths: Purview DLP and sensitivity labels enforced
tool.pricing: Usage-based billing rather than a per-user license (per Microsoft's 2026-09-25 announcement); rates not published.
tool.statusNote: Private preview: announced as Microsoft Scout on 2026-06-02 for Frontier program organisations, renamed Autopilot on 2026-09-25 with private preview expanding at end of September 2026. Not Windows Autopilot (device provisioning).
tool.practitionerNote: Only for Frontier-enrolled tenants for now; preview prerequisites include Intune configuration and opt-in attestation. Plan identity, Purview policy and usage-based cost controls before piloting, since the agent acts continuously under its own identity.

dataResidency.detail: Microsoft says the agent lives in the customer tenant, but no data-residency commitment is published for the preview.

deployment.detail: Microsoft-managed service running across cloud, desktop and web, inside the customer's Microsoft 365 tenant.

auditLogging.detail: Microsoft states it has 'permissions, audit and governance behind it'; the specific audit log surface for the preview is not documented.

soc2.detail: Private-preview service; inclusion in Microsoft 365 compliance scope not yet published.

iso27001.detail: Private-preview service; inclusion in Microsoft 365 compliance scope not yet published.

iso42001.detail: Private-preview service; inclusion in Microsoft 365 compliance scope not yet published.

euAiAct.detail: General-purpose workplace agent; risk class depends on use and the vendor has not published an EU AI Act classification.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Microsoft service built on the MIT-licensed OpenClaw runtime; tied to Microsoft 365 and usage-based billing.
